LEVEL (Czech Republic)
Elden Ring is simply a game that the player naturally adapts to their own style of play. Challenging at times, vicious at others, but mostly incredibly fun. The enjoyable pace makes the hours of play pass by like water, and each path opens up a few more, only to come together again after a fair amount of exploration before the next big reveal. [Issue#318]

Feb 28, 2022
100
IGN Spain
Elden Ring is a superlative title, one of those works capable of becoming an event and becoming engraved in the collective imagination. It achieves this by remaining faithful to its formula and exporting its identity to the concept of the open world, achieving its own personal approach, resulting in a world that is visually stunning, and that works with overwhelming precision in terms of mechanics. An excellent videogame that also maintains the concreteness of its proposal.

The Loadout
Elden Ring packs its intricately crafted world - a world which should be used as a reference point for open-world design moving forward - with more impressive boss fights and secrets than you can shake a giant greatsword at. Although its punishing combat system may not be to everyone’s taste, it is an essential experience both for FromSoftware newcomers and seasoned veterans alike.

100
CD-Action
Elden Ring is a crowning achievement of over a decade of Miyazaki’s and FromSoftware’s work, and an amazing example of how to find a whole new level of fun in a well-known and somewhat worn-out formula. The open world turned out to be a perfect fit for the genre and you can still tell this masterpiece was created by the famous Japanese studio. I honestly haven’t been so excited about a game since the first Dark Souls.

Oct 4, 2026
10
Tarnished_722
This game is a masterpiece from start to finish. It has a special “feeling” to it that i never felt with any game before, and can’t even explain how it feels like, you just have to play it to experience it. That very first moment when you see the Erdtree feels like magic, perfection. That gorgeous view you get presented with when you defeat Godrick and realize you’re not even 10% done into the game, it feels amazing and makes you want to explore every inch of this amazing world FromSoftware crafted. Altus Plateau, oh i just love the Autumn look that this beautiful area has, the golden tones and the fact you’re so close to the Erdtree gives Altus Plateau so much beauty.Everything about this game is perfect,the world,the bosses,the random and secret side quests,the so well written npcs and their backstories,the underground sections,the weapons, everything. An open world so alive and rich in beauty that only Miyazaki‘s creative mind could ever create. I don’t think anything could ever top this,although im looking forward to see and experience what Rockstar is creating.

Aug 29, 2025

C0Ward
Tried getting into Elden Ring a few times, but it just doesn’t click for me. Combat feels slow and clunky, dodging isn’t responsive, and enemy animations are hard to read. Coming from Lies of P, Lords of the Fallen, and Wuchang, this felt like a downgrade in terms of gameplay feel and polish. The world looks big but felt empty and aimless early on. I understand why people love it, but it’s not for me — at least not yet. Might try again later and update my thoughts if it clicks.
